newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh Mangistau oil tender result seen at weekend.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh Mangistau oil tender result seen at weekend.

text.p: The result of a major tender for a 50 to 60 percent stake in Kazakhstan's largest oil producer, Mangistaumunaigaz, has been delayed, a senior Kazakh privatisation official said on Friday.

"The tender committee will meet at the weekend," a senior official at Kazakhstan's State Privatisation Committee who did not want to be named told Reuters. "There may be a decision then but it is not certain."
A decision had been expected on Friday.

Oryx Energy Co and K & B of the United States, Vitol-Kazakhstan (a joint venture with Dutch oil trader and refiner Vitol), Central Asia Petroleum Ltd of Indonesia's Setdco Group, Neft S.A. of Russia and ZAO Mangistaumunaigaz have all submitted bids.
Official privatisation sources say either K & B or Central Asia Petroleum are most likely to win.

The troubled enterprise, located near Kazakhstan's Caspian Sea coast, accounts for about one third of Kazakh oil production and produced six million tonnes of oil (120,000 barrels per day) and 1.8 billion cubic metres of gas in 1995.
